Message:
crypto: testmgr - Reenable sha1/aes in FIPS mode

The combination of sha1 and aes was disabled in FIPS Mode
accidentally.  This patch reenables it.

Fixes: 284a0f6e87b0 ("crypto: testmgr - Disable fips-allowed for...")
